_about: Approved gate commands for tasks the local team proposes. orchestra/admission.py renders a packet's gate only from here: {arg} is filled with a checked argument, never with model text as such. Add a gate or an area here by hand; nothing writes this file.

unittest.about: one unittest module, dotted, whose last part starts with test_ (e.g. orchestra.test_runner)

unittest-discover.about: every test_*.py in one folder (e.g. orchestra/exams)

script-test.about: one self-running test script, scripts/test_*.py or eval/test_*.py

node-test.about: one node:test file, test_*.mjs or *.test.mjs (e.g. orchestra/agent_hub/test_hub.mjs)

run-checks.about: the offline regression suites (scripts/run_checks.py; it has no --fast option today)

_areas: A packet's area is the area of all its scope paths (longest matching prefix; "" matches anything). A packet whose paths span two areas is refused.
